data.short_meaning: Prosperous; thriving; one who populates or revives (ʿĀmir)
data.long_meaning: Aamer (عامر) is the Arabic ʿāmir, 'prosperous, thriving, inhabited', from the root ʿ-m-r (as in ʿumrān, flourishing, and ʿimārah, building). It is a well-attested name.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name points to flourishing and building; any spiritual reading placed on it is interpretive and labelled as such.
data.etymology: Arabic ʿāmir, active participle of ʿamara, 'to populate, to keep in good condition'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aamer total 20, reducing to 2. Number 2 is traditionally associated with its own character. This is an interpretive tradition, not a factual claim.
